slide2Firebase.title: WHAT IS FIREBASE?
slide2Firebase.subtitle: A fully-managed Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) connecting client applications directly to proprietary Google Cloud backend microservices.

services.name: Authentication
services.role: User identity verification & session management (Email/Pass, OAuth, Custom Tokens).

services.name: Database (Firestore)
services.role: Document & JSON NoSQL cloud datastore with realtime synchronization hooks.

services.name: Cloud Storage
services.role: Scalable object storage for user media, file uploads, and static asset blobs.

services.name: Cloud Functions
services.role: Serverless backend compute executing event-driven JavaScript & TypeScript logic.

shiftBanner.title: The Flamebase Shift
shiftBanner.description: Flamebase replicates this exact architecture so apps switch to self-hosted servers simply by swapping service endpoints.

slide3Problems.title: WHY RETHINK FIREBASE?
slide3Problems.subtitle: While managed cloud platforms provide convenience, they impose fundamental infrastructure risks on modern engineering teams.

problems.title: No Data or Infra Control
problems.subtitle: Black-Box Cloud Infrastructure
problems.description: Proprietary backend services cannot be self-hosted, audited, or modified. Developers have zero visibility into runtime internals, and organizations cannot enforce strict local data residency or compliance boundaries.

problems.title: Per-Query Pricing
problems.subtitle: Unpredictable Scaling Invoices
problems.description: Cloud billing charges continuously for every single database read, document write, delete operation, and API invocation. An unexpected traffic surge, loop bug, or viral event can trigger catastrophic billing shocks.

problems.title: Vendor Lock-In
problems.subtitle: Tied to Google Cloud Architecture
problems.description: Applications deeply integrate closed Firebase SDKs and proprietary security rules. Migrating away to alternative hosting providers requires painful, high-cost codebase rewrites and database migrations.

framing.label: Design Goal Framing:
framing.text: Flamebase does not dispute the raw speed of Google's cloud; rather, performance and low RAM overhead are explicit architectural design goals achieved by writing Flamebase natively in Rust.

slide4Solution.title: OUR PROPOSED SOLUTION
slide4Solution.subtitle: A drop-in, self-hosted backend engine built in Rust—delivering complete data sovereignty with zero code rewrites.

pillars.title: 100% Self-Hosted & Open Source
pillars.desc: Full infrastructure control, local data residency, zero proprietary telemetry.

pillars.title: Drop-In Firebase SDK Compatibility
pillars.desc: Forked flamebase-js-sdk has minimal endpoint edits; swap endpoints with zero app refactors.

pillars.title: Rust Speed & Memory Efficiency
pillars.desc: Built with Axum + redb to target blazing microsecond latencies and zero GC pause overhead.

pillars.title: Predictable Flat-Rate Hosting
pillars.desc: Eliminates per-read and per-write invoices. Your only expense is your VPS / hardware.

pillars.title: One-Command Automated Deploy
pillars.desc: Interactive CLI installer auto-provisions Docker containers, reverse proxy, and system services.

diagram.title: Diagram: Flamebase Shift
diagram.sdkNote: Points endpoints to your private server

takeaway.text: Developers keep their Firebase client code, while gaining full infrastructure sovereignty.

slide5Features.title: KEY FEATURES & DEDICATED PORTS
slide5Features.subtitle: Four decoupled, high-speed backend services mirroring Firebase endpoints, plus a unified administrative console.

services.title: Flamebase Authentication
services.details: Full authentication engine supporting Mobile/Email + Password and Google OAuth. The scaffold also includes architectural hooks for anonymous logins and custom token verification.

services.title: Flamebase Database
services.details: High-speed document & JSON data store powered by redb (an embedded, pure-Rust ACID key-value database), replacing Firestore with zero external database server dependencies.

services.title: Flamebase Functions
services.details: Executes custom server-side functions in dedicated Node.js worker runtimes with sandbox boundaries, enabling serverless logic without cloud vendor lock-in.

services.title: Flamebase Storage
services.details: Self-hosted file, media, and asset storage system with direct streaming capabilities and granular permission checking matching Firebase storage buckets.

console.title: Management Console / Dashboard
console.description: Comprehensive web administration dashboard built with Angular for configuring authentication, inspecting redb documents, and monitoring microservices.

slide6Stakeholders.title: STAKEHOLDERS & TARGET AUDIENCE
slide6Stakeholders.subtitle: Designed specifically to empower every role across the product development lifecycle.

stakeholders.desc: Primary consumers of the client SDK across web, Android, and iOS applications with zero learning curve.
Write serverless event-driven Functions, configure redb data schemas, and integrate microservices.
Install, package, and orchestrate Flamebase instances reliably using the automated one-command installer.
Manage user permissions, monitor database metrics, and control security rules via the Angular Console.
Experience high-speed, responsive applications with absolute data privacy and guaranteed uptime.

targetUsers.title: Startups & Small Teams
targetUsers.desc: Looking to reduce and stabilize backend infrastructure costs without unpredictable per-query cloud bills.

targetUsers.title: Students & Indie Developers
targetUsers.desc: Needing an accessible, self-hosted backend platform for hackathons and projects without billing surprises.

targetUsers.title: Organizations & Institutions
targetUsers.desc: Requiring strict data sovereignty, compliance boundaries, and 100% full ownership on private hardware.

slide7TechStack.title: TECHNOLOGIES & ARCHITECTURAL STACK
slide7TechStack.subtitle: A carefully chosen, high-performance technology matrix optimized for developer ergonomics and native speed.

stack.role: High throughput, memory safety without GC pause overhead, low memory footprint.
Embedded ACID key-value store natively handling JSON; zero external DB daemon needed.
Forked TypeScript/JS SDK providing drop-in compatibility with existing Firebase apps.
Administrative web console to manage users, permissions, and inspect live services.
Executes custom user serverless event functions in isolated process sandboxes.
One-command deployment orchestrating containers, ports, and reverse proxies.
Unified Cargo workspace managing the microservices with strict Rust dependency bounds.

slide8Methodology.title: DEVELOPMENT METHODOLOGY
slide8Methodology.subtitle: A phased, sequential microservice build cycle coupled with continuous SDK-driven compatibility testing.

pillars.title: Sequential Service Build
pillars.subtitle: Isolated Milestone Execution
pillars.desc: Services are developed in strict sequence—starting with Authentication, progressing through Database, Storage, and Functions—while developing the Angular Dashboard concurrently to visualize each feature as it lands.

pillars.title: SDK-Driven Verification
pillars.subtitle: Drop-In Contract Guarantee
pillars.desc: Every backend API route is immediately tested directly against the official Firebase JavaScript SDK. No service is marked ready until client operations (auth tokens, reads, writes) succeed against Flamebase without client error.

phases.name: Authentication
phases.details: Email/Password & Google OAuth endpoints scaffolded and tested against flamebase-js-sdk.

phases.name: Database (redb)
phases.details: Embedding redb key-value store with JSON document parser and basic CRUD routes.

phases.name: Storage Engine
phases.details: Chunked binary streaming, file uploads, asset metadata, and bucket permissions.

phases.name: Functions Engine
phases.details: Node.js worker runtime process isolation for executing serverless JS triggers.

phases.name: Angular Console
phases.details: Unified web UI for administrative metrics, schema exploration, and user management.

phases.name: Installer & E2E
phases.details: Single-command deployment verification, systemd/Docker daemon, and production hardening.

slide9Codebase.title: CODEBASE STRUCTURE
slide9Codebase.subtitle: A decoupled, tripartite repository architecture designed for independent testing and rapid release cycles.

repositories.name: flamebase-js-sdk
repositories.desc: Direct fork of official firebase-js-sdk. Retains identical client interfaces while routing network requests to self-hosted Flamebase microservice ports.

repositories.name: flamebase (Monorepo)
repositories.desc: Unified Cargo monorepo containing all 4 core Axum services (Auth, DB, Functions, Storage) and embedded Angular dashboard distribution.
highlights: Cargo workspace with shared crate models

repositories.name: installer
repositories.desc: Streamlined single-command installer script that configures environment variables, Docker networks, TLS reverse proxies, and healthcheck monitors.
